scenario.description: AWS Compute Optimizer continuously analyzes EC2 and EBS usage patterns and generates rightsizing recommendations — for example, migrating from an Intel t3.micro to a Graviton-based t4g.micro (same price, better performance) or upgrading an EBS gp2 volume to gp3 (cheaper and faster). When these recommendations sit unactioned for weeks, it represents pure avoidable waste. the agent should surface aged Compute Optimizer recommendations and propose a sequenced action plan prioritized by savings potential and implementation effort.

### 📊 Analysis Walkthrough

Here is a human-readable breakdown of what the scan found and how the JSON was constructed:

#### What Was Scanned
| Source | API Used | Resources Found |
|---|---|---|
| Compute Optimizer | `GetEC2InstanceRecommendations` | 4 EC2 instances |
| Compute Optimizer | `GetEBSVolumeRecommendations` | 4 EBS volumes (gp2 → gp3) |
| Cost Explorer | `GetRightsizingRecommendation` | 4 EC2 Modify findings |
| CloudWatch | `GetMetricStatistics` | 14-day CPU data per instance |

#### Key Evidence: 30-Day No-Remediation Rule
All 8 resources were **created on 2026-04-15**, making them **105 days old** with no architecture change — qualifying under the ">30 days unremediated" criterion.

| Instance | Avg CPU (14d) | Max CPU | Classification |
|---|---|---|---|
| worker-01 (`i-01baa59f318a3c59e`) | **0.13%** | 13.1% | IDLE |
| web-prod-01 (`i-06286d41ae1218d5e`) | **0.13%** | 11.2% | IDLE |
| api-prod-01 (`i-0aa58fe2d137a2f9f`) | **0.13%** | 13.3% | IDLE |
| web-prod-02 (`i-0ee5fa3508cede8a2`) | **0.14%** | 13.4% | IDLE |

#### Remediation Sequence (Risk-Ordered)
| Priority | Action | Risk | Savings/mo |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1–4 | EBS gp2 → gp3 (online, no downtime) | **Zero** | $0.64 total |
| 5–8 | EC2 t3.micro → t3.nano (same family, change window) | **Low** | $14.68 total |
| 9–12 | EC2 t3.nano → t4g.nano Graviton (ARM64 migration) | **Medium** | ~$2.00 additional |

**Total projected monthly savings: ~$17.32 USD** across all phases.
